entries.1e32650e7f128686: This business researches, develops, manufactures and sells ethical drugs, diagnostic agents, and medical devices and materials. Ethical drugs are manufactured by Sanwa Kagaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights 100.0%), and medical devices and materials are manufactured by Kenz Medico Co., Ltd. (Honjo City, Saitama Prefecture). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥11,933 million, and employees numbered 861 (temporary employees are separately 13, as of March 31, 2026). While Upasita intravenous dialysis syringes and darbepoetin alfa BS injection grew, revenue including intersegment transactions fell 1.9% year on year, due in part to drug price revisions.
entries.265065275816f0ec: This business provides manufacturer support services, including contract logistics for pharmaceutical manufacturers, and digital healthcare services. External logistics (contract logistics for pharmaceutical manufacturers) is handled by Chuo Unyu Co., Ltd. and S.D. Collabo Co., Ltd., while other services are handled by Collabo Square Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥24,629 million, and employees numbered 688 (temporary employees are separately 49, as of March 31, 2026). Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 1.8% year on year, owing in part to an increase in manufacturer logistics contracts in the external logistics business. In addition, the company has started providing services for 'Collabo Portal,' a portal site for healthcare and nursing care professionals operated by Collabo Square Co., Ltd.
entries.3046c12b1b4f8ce5: This business handles, on commission from pharmaceutical manufacturers, the distribution of drugs that require stricter quality and distribution control than general distribution channels, such as drugs for rare diseases.
entries.353b683e5715a120: A pharmaceutical wholesaler that distributes prescription drugs and other products to medical institutions and pharmacies across Japan, and also operates pharmacies and manufactures pharmaceuticals.
entries.496b19ee275164ce: This business provides manufacturer support services, including contract logistics for pharmaceutical manufacturers, and digital healthcare services.
entries.584470723a72473e: This business handles, on commission from pharmaceutical manufacturers, the distribution of drugs that require stricter quality and distribution control than general distribution channels, such as drugs for rare diseases. It is carried out by S.D. Collabo Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights 100.0%). Actual distribution functions, such as sales and delivery to medical institutions, are performed by the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business, so almost all revenue of this business consists of internal transactions with the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were small at ¥6,775 million, while revenue including intersegment transactions rose 47.6% year on year. Employees number 12 (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.5d4301efc7034528: Regional Healthcare and Nursing Care Support
entries.71458e659fcd94f9: This business operates insurance pharmacies and provides nursing care services. Insurance pharmacies are run by Unismile Co., Ltd.; nursing care services are provided by Sanki Welbe Co., Ltd. and Escare Mate Co., Ltd.; and medical and nursing care support, including rental of welfare equipment, is handled by MediCare Collabo Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights 51.0%). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥93,922 million, and employees numbered 3,322 (temporary employees are separately 1,154, as of March 31, 2026). In the insurance pharmacy business, closures reduced the number of operating stores and the number of prescriptions received, so revenue including intersegment transactions fell 0.5% year on year. The insurance pharmacy business is proceeding with closing and transferring unprofitable stores.

entries.b3e1395f6ffe68a7: The core business of SUZUKEN CO.,LTD. sells prescription drugs, diagnostic agents, and medical devices and medical materials. Major companies are the reporting company SUZUKEN CO.,LTD., Sanki Co., Ltd. (Chugoku region), Astis Co., Ltd. (Shikoku region), Shoyaku Co., Ltd. (Kyushu region), SUZUKEN Okinawa Yakuhin Co., Ltd. (Okinawa Prefecture), Nakano Yakuhin Co., Ltd. (Tochigi Prefecture), SUZUKEN Iwate Co., Ltd. (Iwate Prefecture), and S.D. Logi Co., Ltd., which handles logistics operations within the group. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,349,386 million, accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥2,486,647 million. Employees number 7,834 (temporary employees are separately 1,688, as of March 31, 2026). Driven by growth in the prescription drug market and contributions from new specialty drugs, revenue including intersegment transactions rose 3.8% year on year.
